entities.name: Tōru Murata
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Toru Murata  is a Japanese professional baseball pitcher for the Hroši Brno of the Czech Baseball Extraliga. He has previously played in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Yomiuri Giants and Hokkaido Nippon-Ham Fighters, and in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Cleveland Indians.
